build_databricks_chat_config: build a DatabricksConfig instance to validate environment and map OpenAI params for Databricks chat completions
transform_openai_messages_to_databricks: transform OpenAI-format chat messages into Databricks-compatible message format with empty content sanitization
transform_databricks_response_to_openai: transform a Databricks API response into OpenAI-compatible ModelResponse with choices, usage, and reasoning content
iterate_databricks_streaming_chunks: iterate over Databricks streaming response chunks and parse them into ModelResponseStream objects with content and citations
extract_content_from_databricks_response: extract text content, reasoning blocks, and citations from Databricks response content in string or list format
